title: Red panda dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dancing red panda, lit for LED screen on dark background -->
  <!-- tail (behind body) -->
  <path d='M70 68 Q86 66 88 52 Q90 40 80 38 Q74 37 72 44 Q70 50 76 52 Q82 54 80 60 Q78 66 68 66 Z' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <path d='M80 40 Q84 42 84 48 Q84 54 79 56' fill='none' stroke='#6b1f16' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- back legs -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='84' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#8e2b1e'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='86' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#a33427'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='64' rx='17' ry='18' fill='#d35400'/>
  <!-- belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='68' rx='11' ry='12' fill='#f39c12'/>
  <!-- front legs / arms raised dancing -->
  <path d='M36 52 Q26 44 22 32' fill='none' stroke='#a33427' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 52 Q78 44 82 32' fill='none' stroke='#a33427' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='30' r='5' fill='#2c2c4a'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='30' r='5' fill='#2c2c4a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M32 26 Q30 14 40 16 Q44 18 42 26 Z' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <path d='M72 26 Q74 14 64 16 Q60 18 62 26 Z' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <path d='M35 24 Q34 19 38 19 Q40 20 39 24 Z' fill='#f5b7a0'/>
  <path d='M69 24 Q70 19 66 19 Q64 20 65 24 Z' fill='#f5b7a0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='34' rx='19' ry='15' fill='#e8631f'/>
  <!-- white face markings -->
  <path d='M38 32 Q44 28 46 34 Q46 42 40 42 Q35 40 38 32 Z' fill='#fbe3cf'/>
  <path d='M66 32 Q60 28 58 34 Q58 42 64 42 Q69 40 66 32 Z' fill='#fbe3cf'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='40' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#fbe3cf'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='32' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#2c2c4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='32' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#2c2c4a'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='30.5' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='30.5' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose and smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M49 38 Q52 37 55 38 Q54 41 52 41 Q50 41 49 38 Z' fill='#5a2119'/>
  <path d='M52 41 Q48 45 44 43' fill='none' stroke='#5a2119' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 41 Q56 45 60 43' fill='none' stroke='#5a2119' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little dance sparkles -->
  <path d='M14 58 l2 4 4 2 -4 2 -2 4 -2 -4 -4 -2 4 -2 Z' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <path d='M88 62 l1.5 3 3 1.5 -3 1.5 -1.5 3 -1.5 -3 -3 -1.5 3 -1.5 Z' fill='#f1c40f'/>
</svg>
